messages:
sara_sales: ACME's vendor risk team sent back the SIG/CAIQ and flagged IAM section. They want: SAML SP metadata (ACS URL, EntityID, cert thumbprint), proof MFA is required for UI console, RBAC export showing group->role mapping, details on service-account scopes & rotation, and a sample audit log row. Can security/eng confirm what we can hand them and timeline?

emily_security: We can produce all of that. Quick notes: MFA for SSO is enforced by the customer's IdP (we require SAML assertions to include acr or a session duration). For Hosted customers we validate assertion attributes and will reject sessions missing expected claims. For Dedicated/Private we'll document where enforcement is customer-managed. We will provide: SAML SP metadata XML, a redacted audit log (JSONL), an RBAC CSV, a service-account guidance doc that includes TTLs and rotation policy, and an attestation letter. Rachel, will legal need full SOC2 attachments or is a signed attestation enough?

rachel_compliance: For initial vendor review a signed attestation + logs/screenshots is typically sufficient. If they ask for SOC2 evidence we'll route them to the compliance portal (requires an NDA). 48-72h for attestation review from legal.

dan_engineering: Tech details: we support SAML 2.0 (HTTP-POST/Artifact), NameID and transient NameID formats, and SP metadata template includes ACS URL: https://api.redwood.example.com/saml/consume and EntityID: https://redwood.example.com/saml/sp. We'll include cert fingerprint (SHA-256). RBAC: roles are permission sets (e.g., redwood:admin, redwood:deploy, redwood:read). Sample export (CSV) snippet:
```csv
role_id,role_name,permission_count
1,redwood:admin,128
2,redwood:deployer,12
```
Group mapping is by group name attribute by default but SCIM/UUID mapping supported. Service accounts: we recommend OIDC short-lived tokens (1h TTL) + automated rotation; API keys exist but should be rotated every 90 days and scoped via token policies. KMS/HSM integration for secrets; mention available on Dedicated/Private. ETA: I can drop the sample metadata + CSV + audit JSONL by EOD tomorrow.

oliver_cs: I'll request their Okta metadata and a test user. They specifically asked whether MFA for console blocks web-initiated API actions (like clicking a deploy button). Clarify: if the user authenticated via SSO with MFA, API actions initiated in that browser session are allowed; if using long-lived API keys, MFA is not applied. ACME wants a policy note in the RBAC doc.

emily_security: Correct. MFA applies to interactive sessions (SSO) because the IdP attestation includes session age/acr. We do not require MFA for machine-to-machine tokens. We'll add a section "Interactive vs Machine auth" in the guidance doc and include a screenshot of the session claim verification (redacted).

sara_sales: Sound good. Also ACME asked: what happens if IdP group names change or they rename groups? Will mappings break?

dan_engineering: If mapping is by plain group name, renames will break. Recommend SCIM or using immutable group IDs. We'll document both approaches and include a short migration note.

rachel_compliance: Upload the attestation draft to legal@sales.redwood.example.com when ready. Legal needs the textual assertion that MFA is enforced for interactive logins when the IdP policy requires it and that RBAC mapping is configurable.

deploy-bot: Artifact directory created at /confluence/security/iam-evidence. Attachments: pending.

oliver_cs: Proposed POC window: Thu 11:00 PT for SAML handshake + role mapping test (30m). Can eng/security make it?
\edan_engineering: Thu 11:00 PT works. I'll bring: SP metadata, test plan (login -> check claims -> map groups -> perform a deploy action -> verify audit entry).

emily_security: Security will attend and prepare redacted screenshots + the audit JSONL sample. We'll mark all artifacts as redacted and include a short readme that explains redaction.

sara_sales: Great, I'll confirm with ACME. If they request raw logs beyond redacted samples, we'll route that through vendor review/legal. Thanks all :thumbsup:
